title: Permutation in String

content.problemStatement: Given two strings s1 and s2, return true if s2 contains any permutation of s1, otherwise return false.
content.inputFormat:
First line: String s1

Second line: String s2
content.outputFormat:
First line: String s1

Second line: String s2

solution.approach: Fixed-size sliding window of length |s1| comparing character frequency counts with s2.

code.Python3:
import sys
from collections import Counter
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if len(toks) >= 2:
        s1, s2 = toks[0], toks[1]
        n1, n2 = len(s1), len(s2)
        if n1 > n2: print("false"); return
        c1 = Counter(s1)
        c2 = Counter(s2[:n1])
        if c1 == c2: print("true"); return
        for i in range(n1, n2):
            c2[s2[i]] += 1
            c2[s2[i-n1]] -= 1
            if c2[s2[i-n1]] == 0: del c2[s2[i-n1]]
            if c1 == c2: print("true"); return
        print("false")
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

editorial.overview: Maintain character count frequency of s1 and sliding window of size len(s1) in s2. Print 'true' or 'false'.
editorial.approach: Fixed-size sliding window of length |s1| comparing character frequency counts with s2.
